写作 (Writing)
序号 单词 音标 词性 含义 例句
1 obtain /əbˈteɪn/ v. 获得 You can obtain further information from the company's website.
2 gather /ˈɡæðər/ v. 收集 The researchers are now gathering data from the second phase of the study.
3 accumulate /əˈkjuːmjəleɪt/ v. 积累 Over the years, he has accumulated a considerable amount of wealth.
4 conveyor belt /kənˈveɪə belt/ v. 传送带 The novel effectively conveys the atmosphere of the post-war period.
5 wind /waɪnd/ v. 缠绕 She carefully wound the bandage around his injured arm.
6 absorb /əbˈzɔːrb/ v. 吸收 Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
7 classify /ˈklæsɪfaɪ/ v. 分类 The books in the library are classified according to subject.
8 dissolve /dɪˈzɒlv/ v. 溶化；解除 Stir the mixture until the sugar completely dissolves.
9 compress /kəmˈprɛs/ v. 压紧，压缩 This software can be used to compress large files.
10 chop up /tʃɒp ʌp/ 砍碎，切碎 You should chop up the vegetables before adding them to the soup.
11 accelerate /əkˈsɛləreɪt/ v. 加速 The government is taking steps to accelerate the pace of economic reform.
12 activate /ˈæktɪveɪt/ v. 启动，触发 The security alarm will be activated if anyone enters the building.
13 slice /slaɪs/ v. 切片 Would you like me to slice the cake for you?
14 dispatch /dɪˈspætʃ/ v. 派遣；分配 The company aims to dispatch all orders within 24 hours.
